scope: Four focal countries. Readings describe the current evidence; they are not scenario gate values and must not be passed to the quantitative bridge without the bridge's own scenario labelling.

reading_definitions.supported_conditional: Retained positions accept this profile if every stated condition is met.
reading_definitions.disputed: Retained authorities with standing in this country disagree.
reading_definitions.leans_closed: The only retained position for this country rejects the profile, from a weak source.
reading_definitions.conditions_not_met: The documented process fails at least one condition of the retained positions.
reading_definitions.unresolved: No retained position classifies this founder-cell type.
reading_definitions.no_institutional_text_located: No ruling from a relevant institution in this country was located.
reading_definitions.general_route_no_cultivated_scheme: A general halal certification system exists; no scheme for cell-cultured products was found.
reading_definitions.contested_domestic_route: Halal certification is private and politically contested for domestic sale.
reading_definitions.route_exists_no_approval: A food-authorization route covering cell culture exists; no approval was found.
reading_definitions.application_pending: A named application is under process.
reading_definitions.route_announced_status_unknown: A route has been announced; whether it operates is unknown.
reading_definitions.no_route_identified: No authorization route for cultivated meat was identified.
reading_definitions.whole_market_gate: Halal status conditions sale across the market.
reading_definitions.segment_gate: Halal status conditions sale only to a segment of buyers.

confidence_definitions.low: Rests on secondary or snippet-level sources, or on inference alone.
confidence_definitions.medium: Rests on at least one checked source plus consistent leads.
confidence_definitions.high: Rests on checked primary sources with no contrary evidence. Not used yet.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.summary: The legal route exists and has halal built in, but no cultivated product is approved. The religious answer turns on donor procurement: Saudi scholars advising GOOD Meat require a slaughtered donor, while IIFA, whose seminar the SFDA co-organised, keeps a living-donor route.

certification.decisive_next: A Saudi Halal Center scheme or certificate for a cell-cultured product
certification.note: Halal requirements for animal-origin food run through GSO 2055-1 and GSO 993.

food_authorization.decisive_next: The current Arabic SFDA novel-food regulation with its number reconciled (FD 5013 versus 5031 and 513)
food_authorization.note: The novel-food regulation covers animal cell culture; no approval found.

segment.decisive_next: Confirmation that no channel permits non-halal animal-origin novel food
segment.note: Religious and legal gates are coupled.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.summary: The weakest focal country on evidence. A slaughter-required Fatwa Council position is reported only by a tertiary source, and Abu Dhabi's single-window novel-food framework was announced in October 2025 with no operative instrument located.

religious.decisive_next: The UAE Council for Fatwa instrument itself

certification.decisive_next: MoIAT or ADAFSA rules for certifying a cell-cultured product
certification.note: MoIAT runs a halal certificate system through registered bodies; the Abu Dhabi framework would fold halal certification into one window.

food_authorization.decisive_next: The operative ADAFSA framework instrument and any federal counterpart

segment.decisive_next: Federal and emirate rules on sale of non-halal meat and who buys halal-certified meat
segment.note: Licensed non-halal retail exists; segment size unknown.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.summary: No food-authorization route for cultivated meat was identified. The leading Deobandi position, reported but not located in original, requires a slaughtered donor; a Karachi seminary fatwa sets ingredient conditions and withholds a final ruling.

religious.decisive_next: The original Taqi Usmani-led ruling and a translated Banuri Town answer
A named authority's ruling on embryo- or egg-derived founder cells
A named authority's ruling on embryo- or egg-derived founder cells

The original ruling and Council of Islamic Ideology records
Any Pakistani statement on reprogrammed cells

certification.decisive_next: Pakistan Halal Authority rules for a cell-cultured product
certification.note: PS 3733 adopts OIC/SMIIC 1; the Pakistan Halal Authority accredits certifiers.

food_authorization.decisive_next: Federal or provincial novel-food provisions, or a cultivated-meat application
food_authorization.note: Punjab's generic registration procedure is the nearest documented route.

segment.decisive_next: A legal basis for treating halal status as a condition of meat sale
segment.note: Likely whole-market in practice, but the legal basis was not established.

countries.name: India
countries.summary: The only focal country with a named cultivated-chicken application, still under process at FSSAI. No Indian Islamic institution's ruling was located. Halal certification is a contested market layer, so the religious gate covers a segment, not the market.
